findings.title: Demoting the rule an exception widens leaves the exception pointing at a flag, so the drafted rulebook fails validation
findings.detail: demote() on a relax TARGET makes it a flag with no check; the relaxer naming it keeps `relaxes`, so _relaxes_problems reports "which has no check to widen" and CI would fail on the next save. Not a false pass (the target is a flag). Latent: no drafted rule carries relaxes today.
findings.evidence: reviewer/r12_target.py: _relaxes_problems([demote(base), relaxer]) -> ["R-1b.height_bonus: relaxes 'R-1b.height_chart', which has no check to widen"]
findings.suggested_fix: In save_result, after demotions, demote (or drop relaxes from) any relaxer whose target is now a flag, with the cause in notes.
findings.pin: save_result with demoted.yaml naming the target; _relaxes_problems(saved) == []
